```{r}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

DMS_data <- read_csv("./results/functional_scores/DMS_collapsed_data.csv")

DMS_data$Highlight <- with(DMS_data, ifelse(
  (G401_R1_zscore > 2 & G401_R2_zscore > 2) |
  (G401_R1_zscore < -2 & G401_R2_zscore < -2),
  as.character(Mutation_Type),  # use original color if in quadrant
  "Other"                       # else set as "Other"
))

color_map_highlight <- c(
  "M" = "darkgray",
  "F" = "blue",
  "N" = "red",
  "S" = "black",
  "Other" = "white"
)

```


G401
```{r}

library(ggplot2)

subset_data <- subset(
  DMS_data,
  (G401_R1_zscore > 2 & G401_R2_zscore > 2) |
  (G401_R1_zscore < -2 & G401_R2_zscore < -2)
)

r2 <- summary(lm(G401_R2_zscore ~ G401_R1_zscore, data = DMS_data))$r.squared

# Calculate R² on this subset
r2_subset <- summary(lm(G401_R2_zscore ~ G401_R1_zscore, data = subset_data))$r.squared

DMS_data$Mutation_Type <- factor(DMS_data$Mutation_Type, levels = c("M", "N", "F", "S"))

plot_order <- c("N", "F", "S", "M")

# Reorder rows so points are plotted in the desired layer order
DMS_data <- DMS_data[order(match(DMS_data$Mutation_Type, plot_order)), ]

color_map <- c(
  "M" = "gray",
  "F" = "blue",
  "N" = "red",
  "S" = "black"
)

G401 <- ggplot(DMS_data, aes(x = G401_R1_zscore, y = G401_R2_zscore)) +
  # 1. Background: all points in light gray
  geom_point(color = "gray80", alpha = 0.2) +

  # 2. Overlay: colored points in strong quadrants
  geom_point(
    data = subset(DMS_data, 
      (G401_R1_zscore > 2 & G401_R2_zscore > 2) |
      (G401_R1_zscore < -2 & G401_R2_zscore < -2)),
    aes(color = Mutation_Type),
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  # Threshold lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), color = "darkgray", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2), color = "darkgray", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.6) +

  # Manual color scale for Mutation_Type
  scale_color_manual(values = color_map) +

  labs(
    x = "G401 zscore R1",
    y = "G401 zscore R2",
    title = paste("Subset R² (|z| > 2 in both):", round(r2_subset, 4))
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24),           # Axis labels
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20),            # Axis tick labels
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24)
  ) +
  ylim(-20, 20) +
  xlim(-20, 20)

G401


ggsave("./plots/DMS_plots/correlation_plots/g401_rep_correlation.png", plot = G401, width = 6.2, height = 5, dpi = 300)



G401_consistent_signal <- DMS_data %>%
      filter(DMS_data$G401_R1_zscore > 2 & DMS_data$G401_R2_zscore > 2 | DMS_data$G401_R1_zscore < -2 & DMS_data$G401_R2_zscore < -2)

G401_consistent_signal_missense <- G401_consistent_signal %>%
  filter(G401_consistent_signal$Mutation_Type == "M")
```

```{r}
DMS_plot_data <- DMS_data_sig_missense %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(G401_R1_zscore, G401_R2_zscore, 
             BT16_R1_zscore, BT16_R2_zscore,
             RCRF1009T_R1_zscore, RCRF1009T_R2_zscore),
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "zscore"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract cell line and replicate info
    Cell_Line = str_extract(Sample, "^[^_]+"),
    Replicate = str_extract(Sample, "R[12]"),
    # Extract numeric residue position for sorting
    Residue_Num = as.numeric(str_extract(Substitution, "\\d+")),
    # Extract the substitution amino acid
    Sub_AA = str_extract(Substitution, "[A-Z]$"),
    # Order by residue number first, then alphabetically by substitution
    Substitution = factor(Substitution, 
                         levels = unique(Substitution[order(Residue_Num, Sub_AA)]))
  )

# Create the plot
missense <- ggplot(DMS_plot_data, aes(x = Substitution, y = zscore)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Cell_Line), 
             alpha = 0.6, size = 2,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("G401" = "#E41A1C", 
                                 "BT16" = "#377EB8", 
                                 "RCRF1009T" = "#4DAF4A")) +
  labs(
    title = "Substitutions with AVG z-score > 2: Missense",
    x = "Residue Position",
    y = "Z-score",
    color = "Cell Line",
    shape = "Replicate"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -2, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
  ylim(-10,20)

ggsave("./plots/DMS_plots/correlation_plots/missense_sig_mutations_cell_line_correlaions.tif", plot = missense, width = 25, height=4)
```

```{r}
DMS_plot_data_all <- DMS_data_sig %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(G401_R1_zscore, G401_R2_zscore, 
             BT16_R1_zscore, BT16_R2_zscore,
             RCRF1009T_R1_zscore, RCRF1009T_R2_zscore),
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "zscore"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract cell line and replicate info
    Cell_Line = str_extract(Sample, "^[^_]+"),
    Replicate = str_extract(Sample, "R[12]"),
    # Extract numeric residue position for sorting
    Residue_Num = as.numeric(str_extract(Substitution, "\\d+")),
    # Extract the substitution amino acid
    Sub_AA = str_extract(Substitution, "[A-Z]$"),
    # Order by residue number first, then alphabetically by substitution
    Substitution = factor(Substitution, 
                         levels = unique(Substitution[order(Residue_Num, Sub_AA)]))
  )

paired_data_all <- DMS_plot_data_all %>%
  group_by(Substitution, Cell_Line) %>%
  summarise(mean_zscore = mean(zscore, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Cell_Line, values_from = mean_zscore)

paired_data_summary_all <- paired_data_all %>%
  mutate(
    G401_dir = case_when(G401 > 2 ~ "gain", G401 < -2 ~ "loss", TRUE ~ "neutral"),
    BT16_dir = case_when(BT16 > 2 ~ "gain", BT16 < -2 ~ "loss", TRUE ~ "neutral"),
    RCRF_dir = case_when(RCRF1009T > 2 ~ "gain", RCRF1009T < -2 ~ "loss", TRUE ~ "neutral"),
    G401_BT16_agree = G401_dir == BT16_dir,
    BT16_RCRF_agree = BT16_dir == RCRF_dir,
    G401_RCRF_agree = G401_dir == RCRF_dir,
    all_agree = (G401_dir == BT16_dir) & (BT16_dir == RCRF_dir)
  )

summary_stats_all <- paired_data_summary_all %>%
  summarise(
    G401_BT16 = mean(G401_BT16_agree, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    BT16_RCRF = mean(BT16_RCRF_agree, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    G401_RCRF = mean(G401_RCRF_agree, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    All_three = mean(all_agree, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  )

print(summary_stats_all)



paired_data_annotated <- paired_data_all %>%
  mutate(
    both_gain = G401 > 1 & BT16 > 1,
    both_loss = G401 < -1 & BT16 < -1,
    both_neutral = abs(G401) < 1 & abs(BT16) < 1,
    directional_type = case_when(
      both_gain ~ "Both Gain",
      both_loss ~ "Both Loss",
      both_neutral ~ "Both Neutral",
      TRUE ~ "Discordant"
    )
  )

ggplot(paired_data_annotated, aes(x = G401, y = BT16, color = directional_type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dotted", color = "gray70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dotted", color = "gray70") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Both Gain" = "#2166ac", 
               "Both Loss" = "#b2182b",
               "Both Neutral" = "gray60",
               "Discordant" = "#d6604d"),
    name = "Directional Agreement"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Missense: G401 vs BT16",
    subtitle = sprintf("Directional agreement: 71.5%%"),
    x = "G401 z-score",
    y = "BT16 z-score",
    caption = "Dashed line = perfect magnitude agreement\nDotted lines = directional thresholds"
  ) +
  xlim(-2.5, 25) +
  ylim(-2.5, 25)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggVennDiagram)

# Function to annotate and analyze a pair of cell lines
analyze_pair <- function(data, cell_line_1, cell_line_2, name1, name2) {
  
  # Annotate the data
  annotated_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      status_1 = case_when(
        .data[[cell_line_1]] > 2 ~ "gain",
        .data[[cell_line_1]] < -2 ~ "loss",
        TRUE ~ "neutral"
      ),
      status_2 = case_when(
        .data[[cell_line_2]] > 2 ~ "gain",
        .data[[cell_line_2]] < -2 ~ "loss",
        TRUE ~ "neutral"
      ),
      agreement_type = case_when(
        status_1 == "gain" & status_2 == "gain" ~ "Both Gain",
        status_1 == "loss" & status_2 == "loss" ~ "Both Loss",
        status_1 == "neutral" & status_2 == "neutral" ~ "Both Neutral",
        TRUE ~ "Discordant"
      )
    )
  
  # Calculate concordance statistics
  concordance_summary <- annotated_data %>%
    count(agreement_type) %>%
    mutate(
      percentage = n / sum(n) * 100,
      is_concordant = agreement_type %in% c("Both Gain", "Both Loss", "Both Neutral")
    )
  
  # Overall concordance rate
  concordance_rate <- concordance_summary %>%
    filter(is_concordant) %>%
    summarise(
      total_concordant = sum(n),
      total = sum(concordance_summary$n),
      concordance_pct = total_concordant / total * 100
    )
  
  # Concordant gains
  both_gain <- sum(annotated_data$status_1 == "gain" & annotated_data$status_2 == "gain")
  total_n <- sum(nrow(annotated_data))
  
  # Correlation for concordant gains
  sig_concordant_data <- annotated_data %>%
    filter(agreement_type == "Both Gain")
  
  cor_result <- NULL
  if(nrow(sig_concordant_data) > 2) {
    cor_result <- cor.test(sig_concordant_data[[cell_line_1]], 
                           sig_concordant_data[[cell_line_2]])
  }
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(annotated_data, aes(x = .data[[cell_line_1]], y = .data[[cell_line_2]], 
                                   color = agreement_type)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dotted", color = "gray70") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dotted", color = "gray70") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Both Gain" = "#2166ac", 
                 "Both Loss" = "#b2182b",
                 "Both Neutral" = "gray60",
                 "Discordant" = "#d6604d"),
      name = "Agreement"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("%s vs %s", name2, name1),
      subtitle = sprintf("Concordance: %.1f%% | Concordant gains: %d (%.1f%%)", 
                        concordance_rate$concordance_pct,
                        both_gain,
                        both_gain/total_n * 100),
      x = sprintf("%s z-score", name1),
      y = sprintf("%s z-score", name2)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2.5, 25), ylim = c(-2.5, 25)) +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  
  # Return results
  list(
    data = annotated_data,
    plot = p,
    concordance_summary = concordance_summary,
    concordance_rate = concordance_rate,
    cor_test = cor_result,
    both_gain = both_gain,
    total = total_n
  )
}

# Analyze all three pairs
pair1 <- analyze_pair(paired_data_all, "RCRF1009T", "BT16", "RCRF1009T", "BT16")
pair2 <- analyze_pair(paired_data_all, "RCRF1009T", "G401", "RCRF1009T", "G401")
pair3 <- analyze_pair(paired_data_all, "BT16", "G401", "BT16", "G401")

# Print summaries
cat("\n=== RCRF1009T vs BT16 ===\n")
print(pair1$concordance_summary)
cat(sprintf("\nOverall concordance: %.1f%%\n", pair1$concordance_rate$concordance_pct))
cat(sprintf("Concordant gains: %d (%.1f%%)\n", pair1$both_gain, 
            pair1$both_gain/pair1$total * 100))
if(!is.null(pair1$cor_test)) {
  cat(sprintf("Correlation (concordant gains): r = %.3f, p = %.2e\n", 
              pair1$cor_test$estimate, pair1$cor_test$p.value))
}

cat("\n=== RCRF1009T vs G401 ===\n")
print(pair2$concordance_summary)
cat(sprintf("\nOverall concordance: %.1f%%\n", pair2$concordance_rate$concordance_pct))
cat(sprintf("Concordant gains: %d (%.1f%%)\n", pair2$both_gain, 
            pair2$both_gain/pair2$total * 100))
if(!is.null(pair2$cor_test)) {
  cat(sprintf("Correlation (concordant gains): r = %.3f, p = %.2e\n", 
              pair2$cor_test$estimate, pair2$cor_test$p.value))
}

cat("\n=== BT16 vs G401 ===\n")
print(pair3$concordance_summary)
cat(sprintf("\nOverall concordance: %.1f%%\n", pair3$concordance_rate$concordance_pct))
cat(sprintf("Concordant gains: %d (%.1f%%)\n", pair3$both_gain, 
            pair3$both_gain/pair3$total * 100))
if(!is.null(pair3$cor_test)) {
  cat(sprintf("Correlation (concordant gains): r = %.3f, p = %.2e\n", 
              pair3$cor_test$estimate, pair3$cor_test$p.value))
}

# === THREE-WAY OVERLAP ANALYSIS ===

# Identify significant gains in each cell line
# Assuming you have a mutation identifier column - adjust name as needed
gains_BT16 <- paired_data_all %>% 
  filter(BT16 > 2) %>% 
  pull(1)  # Pulls first column as mutation ID - adjust if needed

gains_RCRF <- paired_data_all %>% 
  filter(RCRF1009T > 2) %>% 
  pull(1)

gains_G401 <- paired_data_all %>% 
  filter(G401 > 2) %>% 
  pull(1)

# Create Venn diagram list
venn_list <- list(
  BT16 = gains_BT16,
  RCRF1009T = gains_RCRF,
  G401 = gains_G401
)

# Create Venn diagram
venn_plot <- ggVennDiagram(venn_list, 
                           label_alpha = 0,
                           category.names = c("BT16", "RCRF1009T", "G401")) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2166ac") +
  labs(title = "Overlap of Significant Gain Mutations (z > 2)",
       subtitle = "Across Three Rhabdoid Tumor Cell Lines") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(venn_plot)

# Calculate overlap statistics
all_three <- Reduce(intersect, list(gains_BT16, gains_RCRF, gains_G401))
at_least_two <- unique(c(
  intersect(gains_BT16, gains_RCRF),
  intersect(gains_BT16, gains_G401),
  intersect(gains_RCRF, gains_G401)
))

total_mutations <- nrow(paired_data_all)

cat("\n=== THREE-WAY OVERLAP SUMMARY ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Total mutations analyzed: %d\n", total_mutations))
cat(sprintf("Significant gains in BT16: %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
            length(gains_BT16), length(gains_BT16)/total_mutations*100))
cat(sprintf("Significant gains in RCRF1009T: %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
            length(gains_RCRF), length(gains_RCRF)/total_mutations*100))
cat(sprintf("Significant gains in G401: %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
            length(gains_G401), length(gains_G401)/total_mutations*100))
cat(sprintf("\nConsensus hits (all 3 cell lines): %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
            length(all_three), length(all_three)/total_mutations*100))
cat(sprintf("Replicated in ≥2 cell lines: %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
            length(at_least_two), length(at_least_two)/total_mutations*100))

# Cell line-specific hits
specific_BT16 <- setdiff(gains_BT16, c(gains_RCRF, gains_G401))
specific_RCRF <- setdiff(gains_RCRF, c(gains_BT16, gains_G401))
specific_G401 <- setdiff(gains_G401, c(gains_BT16, gains_RCRF))

cat(sprintf("\nCell line-specific gains:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  BT16 only: %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
            length(specific_BT16), length(specific_BT16)/total_mutations*100))
cat(sprintf("  RCRF1009T only: %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
            length(specific_RCRF), length(specific_RCRF)/total_mutations*100))
cat(sprintf("  G401 only: %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
            length(specific_G401), length(specific_G401)/total_mutations*100))

# Combine all plots
combined_plot <- (pair1$plot / pair2$plot / pair3$plot) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Pairwise Cell Line Concordance Analysis",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))
  )

print(combined_plot)

# Save plots
ggsave("./plots/three_cellline_comparison.tif", combined_plot, width = 10, height = 14, dpi = 300)
ggsave("./plots/venn_diagram_overlap.tif", venn_plot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Create comprehensive summary table
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Comparison = c("RCRF1009T vs BT16", "RCRF1009T vs G401", "BT16 vs G401"),
  Total_Mutations = c(pair1$total, pair2$total, pair3$total),
  Concordance_Pct = c(pair1$concordance_rate$concordance_pct,
                      pair2$concordance_rate$concordance_pct,
                      pair3$concordance_rate$concordance_pct),

                           pair2$both_gain/pair2$total * 100,
                           pair3$both_gain/pair3$total * 100),
  Correlation_r = c(

    ifelse(!is.null(pair2$cor_test), pair2$cor_test$estimate, NA),
    ifelse(!is.null(pair3$cor_test), pair3$cor_test$estimate, NA)
  ),
  Correlation_Pvalue = c(
    ifelse(!is.null(pair1$cor_test), pair1$cor_test$p.value, NA),
    ifelse(!is.null(pair2$cor_test), pair2$cor_test$p.value, NA),
    ifelse(!is.null(pair3$cor_test), pair3$cor_test$p.value, NA)
  )
)

cat("\n=== PAIRWISE COMPARISON SUMMARY TABLE ===\n")

# Create overlap summary table
overlap_table <- data.frame(
  Category = c("Total mutations", 
               "BT16 gains", "RCRF1009T gains", "G401 gains",
               "All 3 cell lines (consensus)", 
               "≥2 cell lines",
               "BT16 only", "RCRF1009T only", "G401 only"),
  Count = c(total_mutations,

                 length(specific_RCRF)/total_mutations*100,

)

cat("\n=== OVERLAP SUMMARY TABLE ===\n")

# Save summary tables
write.csv(summary_table, "./plots/cellline_pairwise_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

}
```
